author: reek
body: Courtyard for two-terminal chip components. The courtyard extends from the outer edge of each pad plus the density margin.

author: reek
body: Generates pads for SOIC packages. Pins are numbered sequentially: 1 through pin-count/2 on the left side (negative X), then pin-count/2+1 through pin-count on the right side (positive X), mirrored vertically.

author: reek
body: Generates pads for QFP packages with leads on all four sides. Pin numbering starts at pin 1 on the left side and proceeds counter-clockwise: left, bottom, right, top.

author: reek
body: Generates pads for BGA packages in a regular grid. Each pad is a circle with diameter equal to the ball diameter. Grid origin is centered on the package body.

author: reek
body: Generates a human-readable IPC package name from the package type and body dimensions in nanometers. Dimensions are converted to tenths of mm for the name string.
